cytra-shulkerview.settings.title: Shulker View
cytra-shulkerview.option.itemIcon.hint: Shows the item inside a shulker (or other container) when every stack is the same item
cytra-shulkerview.option.itemBar.hint: A bar along the bottom of the slot showing how full the container is
cytra-shulkerview.option.itemIconSize.hi: Share of the slot the icon covers
Hovering a shulker or other container shows its contents as a grid instead of the text list
ShulkerBoxTooltip is installed and shows its own preview
cytra-shulkerview.option.tooltipKeyStyle: Alloy: the preview always shows, the preview key switches view. ShulkerBoxTooltip: only while holding the preview key, plus the full key for the other view
cytra-shulkerview.option.tooltipFirstVie: Compact shows each item once with its total; Full shows every slot where it is
cytra-shulkerview.option.previewKey.hint: Hold it to switch view (Alloy keys) or to show the preview (ShulkerBoxTooltip keys)
Held together with the preview key, shows the other view
The preview window takes the shulker box's colour
cytra-shulkerview.option.tooltipLootTabl: Names the loot table of unopened loot chests and shulkers
cytra-shulkerview.option.otherContainers: Icon, fill bar and preview for any block item carrying items (Ctrl+pick block), modded ones too
cytra-shulkerview.option.enderChestPrevi: Your ender chest on ender chest items: live when the server has this mod, otherwise as you last closed it
cytra-shulkerview.option.placedLabels.hi: Icon and fill bar on the four side faces, like an item frame
Labels further away than this many blocks are not drawn
Share of the face the icon covers
cytra-shulkerview.option.namedTextures.h: Uses Alloy Pack textures on placed shulkers named Trash, Tools, Food or Blocks
